strings.ui_settings_delegation: Allow listed admins to edit settings
strings.step_aside_worldtools: Thing's world tools that {0} also offers are hidden; people, messages and server configuration stay.
strings.off_no_crucible: Thing is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_thing: This server does not run Thing: Thing is off for this session.
strings.refused_not_admin: Only server admins can do that.
strings.refused_no_other_players: Not available in single player: there is no one else.
strings.refused_product_off: Thing is off for this session.
strings.refused_needs_relay: Run this from the server console.
strings.import_done: Imported {0} settings from {1}. The original files are unchanged.
strings.kicked: You were removed from the server by an admin. Reason: {0}
strings.player_frozen: An admin froze you. Menus and chat still work.
strings.banned: You are banned from this server. Reason: {0}
strings.banned_for: You are banned from this server for {0}. Reason: {1}
strings.muted_until_lifted: You are muted until an admin lifts it.
strings.you_are_muted: You are muted: your message was not sent.
strings.shutdown_warning: The server shuts down in {0} minutes.
strings.temp_ban_lifted: The temporary ban of {0} has ended.
strings.cmd_help: thing help | status | kick <player> [reason] | ban <player> [reason] | tempban <player> <duration: 90m, 24h, 3d> [reason] | unban <platform id> | warn <player> <reason> | mute <player> [duration|forever] [reason] | unmute <player|platform id> | say <text> | saytop <text> | shutdown <minutes> | cancelshutdown | save | thing drops; thing drops confirm; thing drops cancel | thing seed | thing ward [on|off] | freeze <player> | unfreeze <player> | thing grant self | thing grant <platform id> <world|spawn|teleport|freeze|inventory|ward> <on|off>
strings.cmd_remote_sent: Sent to the server; waiting for its answer.
strings.cmd_remote_failed: The server did not run the command ({0}).
strings.terrain_usage: Use thing terrain <radius 1–50>, thing terrain confirm, or thing terrain cancel.
strings.terrain_incomplete: Terrain reset canceled: the full area or player identity could not be checked.
strings.terrain_ownership: Terrain reset canceled: the area has mixed or unavailable terrain ownership.
strings.terrain_other_pieces: Terrain reset canceled: the area includes another player's pieces or an unknown creator.
strings.terrain_expired: Terrain preview expired or the player moved; request a new preview.
strings.terrain_preview: Yellow preview: {0} m. Stay here and run thing terrain confirm within 20 seconds, or thing terrain cancel.
strings.terrain_unknown: Terrain outcome is unknown. Check the area before requesting another reset.
strings.drops_usage: Use thing drops, thing drops confirm, or thing drops cancel.
strings.drops_unavailable: Drop cleanup canceled before removal: the player or item owner is unavailable.
strings.drops_expired: Drop confirmation expired or the player/settings changed; request it again.
strings.drops_preview: Remove {0} loaded loose stacks within {1} m? Stay here and run thing drops confirm within 20 seconds, or thing drops cancel.
strings.drops_done: Drop cleanup completed: {0} loose stacks removed.
strings.drops_unknown: Drop cleanup may be partial; check the area before another request. No automatic retry.
strings.seed_unavailable: World seed is unavailable until a world is loaded.
strings.ward_usage: Use thing ward to toggle, or thing ward on / thing ward off.
strings.ward_unavailable: Ward override needs a current character and a fresh server confirmation.
strings.ward_on: Ward override enabled for this character; server confirmation is refreshed while connected.
strings.time_unavailable: Global time is unavailable until the authority has loaded its world clock.
strings.ui_select_ban: Select a ban in the moderation ledger.
strings.ui_world_step_aside: World tools are handled by the detected administration mod.
strings.mute_persistence_unknown: The live mute changed, but its saved state could not be verified. Inspect the server ledger before another edit; no automatic retry was made.
strings.delve_unavailable: Delve is not available on this authority, or its adapter version is unsupported.
strings.delve_none_active: None of the selected regeneration kinds is active.
strings.delve_requested_skip: Queued {0} for the next check without its delay. Player and building guards still apply.
strings.delve_requested_due: Queued {0} for evaluation with normal delays. Player and building guards still apply.
strings.ui_delve_request_warning: Request this kind at its next check? Delays apply unless the server cheat and your Mischief permission both allow skipping them.
strings.ui_delve_dryrun_hint: Dry run for this kind. The server's Dry Run All setting overrides it. If the server changed it meanwhile, refresh and try again.
strings.ui_delve_scope: Requests cover all due sites of the chosen kind. Delve does not offer nearest-site requests or lists of single due sites here.
strings.ui_world_console_result: The world-tool result is shown in the game console.
strings.ui_request_failed: The request failed. Refresh before trying again.
strings.ui_hold: Controller: select Confirm and hold A to continue.
strings.ui_read_failed: The server could not read this list.
strings.ui_audit_bounded: Recent audit entries only; the full log stays on the server.
strings.ui_admin_readonly: The server has disabled in-game admin-list editing.
strings.ui_select_identity: Select an identity in this list first.
strings.message_stale: The source changed. Refresh and edit the current version.
strings.message_invalid: Invalid message or announcement file. Use at most 500 characters; announcements must fit on one line.
strings.message_unknown: The outcome is uncertain. Refresh and inspect the server files before another edit. Nothing was retried automatically.
strings.message_failed: The edit could not be completed. Refresh before trying again.
strings.ui_motd_hint: Shown on join, up to 500 characters. Empty text clears it.
strings.ui_announcement_hint: One line, up to 500 characters. Repeat every 1–1440 real minutes.
strings.ui_clear_announcements_warning: Remove all recurring announcements? Existing file comments will stay.
strings.teleport_usage: Use thing goto <player> or thing bring <player>.
strings.teleport_unavailable: Teleport unavailable. Check current players, permissions and ownership.
strings.teleport_unknown: Teleport outcome uncertain. Inspect the current position before another request; nothing was retried.
strings.teleport_expired: Teleport request expired or its participants or permissions changed.
strings.teleport_declined: The player declined the teleport request.
strings.teleport_busy: This player already has a pending teleport request.
strings.teleport_waiting: The target was prompted. Waiting for their decision, for up to 30 seconds.
strings.teleport_accepted: The native teleport was accepted. Arrival has not been acknowledged.
strings.teleport_prompt_goto: {0} asks to teleport to you. This request expires in 30 seconds.
strings.teleport_prompt_bring: {0} asks to bring you to their position. This request expires in 30 seconds.
strings.teleport_unsafe: The landing was unsafe. One return to the departure position was attempted.
strings.teleport_arrived: Teleport arrived and the local landing checks passed.
strings.teleport_recovering: The landing is unsafe. You will be returned to where you left from as soon as the game's teleport is ready.
strings.config_unavailable: Server configuration is unavailable, too large, or no longer permitted.
strings.config_unbound: Read-only file: Thing cannot edit this file from here.
strings.config_readonly: You cannot change this entry from here.
strings.config_invalid: Invalid typed value. Choose a value allowed by the server entry.
strings.config_stale: The file, value, owner, session or policy changed. Refresh before editing again.
strings.config_saved: The configured value was saved and its live entry and disk value were verified.
strings.config_unknown: The write outcome is uncertain. Inspect the live entry and disk before another edit; no retry or corrective write was sent.
strings.config_failed: The configuration edit could not be started. No write was retried.
strings.ui_config_hint: Open permitted server configuration. Secret and hidden entries are withheld. Unsupported or unbound files are read-only.
strings.ui_config_select: Select a file or entry first.
strings.ui_config_write_warning: Apply this typed value to the current server configuration? A stale version is refused.
strings.ui_config_restart: This entry requires a restart for full effect.
strings.ui_config_choose_value: Choose at least one declared value.
strings.ui_config_yaml_hint: The owning mod validates and applies this document. Its source is refreshed before uploading; changed files are refused.
strings.config_yaml_saved: The owner accepted the YAML edit and its live text and disk text were verified.
strings.delve_position_unknown: The current authenticated character position is unavailable.
strings.ui_delve_site_scope: Known dungeon resource/full-reset clocks only, from the last owner inventory. Delay elapsed does not guarantee safe regeneration. Flat entrance distance; this page does not reset sites.
strings.delve_nearest_none: No known dungeon currently uses the active full-reset mode.
strings.delve_nearest_queued: Queued {0} ({1}) for one guarded reset. It is skipped if anyone is inside or a grave, player building or player base is there. Check recent Delve actions for the outcome.
strings.delve_nearest_refused: The nearest-site request was refused. Refresh before another attempt.
strings.ui_delve_reset_nearest_warning: Reset the nearest known dungeon from your position? Its interior is wiped and generated again. It is skipped if anyone is inside and is not retried automatically.
strings.ui_delve_nature_scope: Up to 10000 remembered nature resources in stable order, using zone visit clocks. Elapsed delay does not prove damage, removal or safe regeneration. Chest and spawner site lists are not supported here.
strings.pickup_usage: Use thing pickup <1-10|reset>: your own item pickup radius in meters (admins only).
strings.pickup_set: Your item pickup radius is now {0} m until you reset it, leave the world or stop being an admin.
strings.pickup_reset: Your item pickup radius is back to the game's {0} m.
strings.ui_pickup_radius_hint: Your own item pickup radius, 1 to 10 meters. Type reset to go back to the game's radius.
strings.ui_regenerate_nature_warning: Felled trees and cleared bushes come back in generated zones around you (Delve Surface Reset Radius). Nothing returns near player buildings, inside locations or next to a player.
strings.ui_reset_resources_warning: Due dungeon resources are queued, and mined rocks, ore and picked stones, flint and branches come back in generated zones around you. Nothing returns near player buildings, inside locations or next to a player.
strings.ui_settings_delegation_hint: On lets listed admins edit permitted server settings remotely. Off removes that delegation. Server scope and security rules still apply.
strings.ui_freeze_hint: On sets the chosen time and freezes the global clock. Off sets the time without freezing it.
strings.ui_top_left_hint: On shows the broadcast at the top left. Off shows it in the center.
strings.ui_clock_hint: Enter a time as HH:mm or a supported time preset.
strings.ui_reason_hint: Reason for this moderation action. Server policy may require one.
strings.ui_minutes_hint: Real minutes until the scheduled server shutdown.
strings.ui_platform_id_hint: Exact platform ID of the player to add to this list.
strings.ui_duration_hint: Use m, h, or d, such as 90m, 24h, or 3d. Mutes also accept forever.
strings.ui_terrain_radius_hint: Request a terrain-reset preview within 1–50 meters. Confirmation is separate.
strings.ui_apply_hint: Apply uses the entered values. The action may require confirmation.
strings.ui_cancel_hint: Close this form without applying the entered values.
strings.ui_help_close: Close this panel. Actions already accepted by the server remain applied.
strings.ui_help_refresh: Read the current page again from the server without running a management action.
strings.ui_help_previous: Read the previous page of this list.
strings.ui_help_next: Read the next page of this list.
strings.ui_help_identity_lists: Cycle the online-player, permitted-identity, admin, and permissions lists. This changes the displayed list, not its membership.
strings.ui_help_delve_views: Cycle regeneration kinds, recent actions, due sites, nearest sites and nature status. Viewing a list does not regenerate anything.
strings.ui_help_moderation_views: Switch between recent audit entries and the moderation ledger. Viewing records does not moderate a player.
strings.ui_help_select: Select this entry for the actions below. Selection alone changes no player, list or world state.
strings.ui_help_tab_people: Inspect online players and native permitted/admin lists, then choose a player or identity action.
strings.ui_help_tab_moderation: Review the audit log and moderation ledger, including entries eligible for unbanning.
strings.ui_help_tab_messages: Manage broadcasts, the message of the day, recurring announcements and scheduled shutdowns.
strings.ui_help_tab_world: Inspect or change world utilities. Destructive resets use their existing preview or confirmation paths.
strings.ui_help_tab_regeneration: Inspect Delve regeneration status and request the supported regeneration actions.
strings.ui_help_kick: Open a reason prompt to disconnect the selected player. The server rechecks permission before applying it.
strings.ui_help_ban: Open a reason prompt to ban the selected player and disconnect them after confirmation.
strings.ui_help_tempban: Choose a ban duration and reason for the selected player, then confirm the temporary ban.
strings.ui_help_warn: Write a warning to the selected player through the moderation system.
strings.ui_help_mute: Choose how long to mute the selected player and provide a reason.
strings.ui_help_unmute: Request removal of the selected player's chat mute.
strings.ui_help_freeze_player: Stop the selected player from moving or using actions. Menus and chat still work. The server checks that you may freeze players. This ends when you unfreeze them or they disconnect.
strings.ui_help_unfreeze_player: Let the selected player move again. The server checks that you may unfreeze players.
strings.ui_help_goto: Confirm travel to the selected player. Existing teleport permissions and checks still apply.
strings.ui_help_bring: Confirm bringing the selected player to you. Existing teleport permissions and checks still apply.
strings.ui_help_unban: Confirm removal of the selected ban entry from the moderation ledger.
strings.ui_help_permit: Add a platform identity to the native permitted-player list after review.
strings.ui_help_unpermit: Confirm removal of the selected platform identity from the permitted-player list.
strings.ui_help_admin_add: Add a platform identity to the native admin list when admin-list editing is allowed.
strings.ui_help_admin_remove: Confirm removal of the selected identity from the native admin list. Admin-list editing must be allowed.
strings.ui_help_broadcast: Compose a server broadcast and choose its message location before sending.
strings.ui_help_shutdown: Schedule a server shutdown after the entered number of minutes and confirmation.
strings.ui_help_save_world: Request a world save through the existing server command.
strings.ui_help_motd: Edit the current message of the day. An empty submitted message clears it after review.
strings.ui_help_announcements: Open the recurring-announcement editor to review messages and repeat intervals.
strings.ui_help_seed: Show this world's seed through the server command.
strings.ui_help_time: Choose the world clock time and optionally freeze time progression. Opening the editor changes nothing.
strings.ui_help_resume_time: Release the clock freeze and resume normal world-time progression.
strings.ui_help_ward_on: Request a ward-access override for your current character and session, subject to server rules. Ward ownership is unchanged.
strings.ui_help_ward_off: Release your character's ward-access override. Ward ownership is unchanged.
strings.ui_help_terrain: Preview a terrain reset within the entered radius, then review and confirm it. Destructive changes are not made by opening the editor.
strings.ui_help_drops: Preview eligible loose-item cleanup and confirm before removing the displayed drops.
strings.ui_help_add: Add a recurring announcement by entering its text and repeat interval.
strings.ui_help_edit: Edit the selected recurring announcement's text or repeat interval.
strings.ui_help_remove: Confirm removal of the selected recurring announcement.
strings.ui_help_grants: Show the permissions stored on the server for this world, including platform ids that are offline. A listed admin still has every right.
strings.ui_help_grant_world: Lets this player use world time, terrain reset, dropped-item cleanup, the world seed, and Hex debug kill, drops, tame, and stop event. Kick, ban, and server settings stay with listed admins. A server switch that is off still refuses the tool.
strings.ui_help_grant_spawn: Lets this player spawn when that cheat is admins-only. It does not take spawn away from players the server already allows, and it does not allow spawn when the server allows nobody.
strings.ui_help_grant_teleport: Lets this player go to another player or bring that player to them. The server still asks the other player when confirmation is on.
strings.ui_help_grant_freeze: Lets this player freeze or unfreeze another player for this connection. It does not allow kick, ban, mute, or warn.
strings.ui_help_grant_inventory: Lets this player view a connected player's inventory and take or delete one stack. The server moves the stack so it is not copied. Delete asks twice and is written to the server log.
strings.ui_help_grant_ward: Lets this player bypass ward protection for their own character while the server allows ward override. Turning the server switch off stops the bypass.
strings.ui_help_inventory: View the selected player's inventory. Take or delete asks the server to move or remove that one stack. Nothing is copied.
strings.ui_inventory_empty: This player is not carrying anything this view can list.
strings.ui_inventory_take_body: Take {0} ({1}) from this player? The server reserves that stack and creates a protected pickup at your feet before removing it from the player. Pick it up into an empty inventory slot.
strings.ui_inventory_delete_body: Delete {0} ({1}) from this player? The server will ask you to confirm once more before it is destroyed.
strings.ui_inventory_delete_again: Delete {0} ({1}) permanently? This cannot be undone.
strings.ui_inventory_stored: The stack is in your inventory.
strings.ui_inventory_dropped: The stack is at your feet. Pick it up into an empty inventory slot.
strings.ui_inventory_deleted: The stack was deleted and the server logged it.
strings.ui_inventory_missing: That stack is no longer in that slot.
strings.ui_inventory_busy: An inventory transfer is already in progress.
strings.ui_inventory_denied: The server refused this inventory action.
strings.ui_inventory_failed: The inventory action did not finish. Check the server log before trying a different stack.
strings.ui_permissions_failed: The server did not return this player's permissions.
strings.ui_permissions_empty: Select a player to see permissions.
strings.ui_help_grant_add: Store a platform id that is offline so you can grant rights before they join. A name is not accepted.
strings.ui_help_grant_remove: Remove this platform id and its stored rights from this world.
strings.grant_saved: The permission was saved on the server for this world.
strings.grant_unsaved: The permission could not be written. Check the server permissions file before editing it again.
strings.cfg_general__admin_window_key_help: Opens and closes the Thing admin window (admins only; others see a short hint). Empty: none.
strings.cfg_general__confirm_destructive_actions: Asks before kick, ban, terrain reset, remove drops and remote configuration writes.
strings.cfg_general__admin_list_editable_in_game: Lets existing admins add and remove admins in game. Off: adminlist.txt is changed only on the server.
strings.cfg_general__audit_log_days_help: Days the audit log keeps its daily files.
strings.cfg_general__show_platform_ids_help: Shows platform IDs in the player list (to admins only either way).
strings.cfg_general__locked_player_settings_help: Comma list of Local Thing settings (Section.Key) every player uses with the server's value.
strings.cfg_moderation__kick_reason_required_hel: Kicks, bans and warnings need a reason.
strings.cfg_moderation__temp_ban_default_hours_h: Length of a temporary ban when the admin gives none.
strings.cfg_moderation__mute_default_minutes_hel: Length of a mute when the admin gives none.
strings.cfg_moderation__teleport_requires_confir: A player brought to an admin must accept first.
strings.cfg_communication__message_of_the_day_he: Shown to each player on joining; empty for none (up to 500 characters, sent as written).
strings.cfg_communication__shutdown_warning_minu: Minutes before a shutdown at which everyone is warned (comma list, 1 to 120).
strings.cfg_world_administration__terrain_reset_: Largest terrain reset radius in meters.
Non-admins may reset terrain around their own pieces only.
strings.cfg_world_administration__remove_drops_r: Radius in meters of remove drops.
strings.cfg_world_administration__remove_drops_f: Every player may remove loose drops around themselves. Off: admins only.
strings.cfg_world_administration__global_time_re: A frozen global time is released when the admin who set it leaves or loses admin rights.
strings.cfg_world_administration__ward_override_: Confirmed admins may bypass ward protection for their own character for the session.
strings.cfg_remote_configuration__remote_config_: Admins may read and edit server configuration from inside the game.
Files the remote editor may open: Meadworks files only, those plus the allow list, or every config file.
Comma list of other file names in BepInEx/config the remote editor may open.
strings.cfg_remote_configuration__remote_backup_: Backups kept per file before remote writes.
strings.cfg_hotkeys__ward_override_key_help: Optional key that turns the ward override on or off. Admins only.
strings.cfg_hotkeys__remove_drops_key_help: Optional key that previews the dropped items within Remove Drops Radius around you; run thing drops confirm to remove them. Admins only.
